jamie: hey @alex @priya — i've addressed the checklist from the last review and split the change into two commits (refactor + fixes). added a smoke test for the new path and updated the README. PTAL when you get a minute. link: https://git.company/repo/pull/842 :wave:

alex: thanks jamie. quick skim — did you keep the previous retry/backoff semantics? i didn't see the old helper in the refactor

jamie: yes — kept semantics. moved the helper to runtime/retry.go and added unit tests. snippet:
```
// backoff returns exponential backoff with jitter
func backoff(attempt int) time.Duration {
  base := 150 * time.Millisecond // tuned for fast short ops
  max := 3 * time.Second
  // ...
}
```

priya: small thing — can you add a one-line comment explaining the 150ms base choice (historical reasons + avoids thundering herd). otherwise looks good to me. also added a tiny docstring on the new exported func?

jamie: done — added the comment and docstring, and updated the smoke test to assert retry count. also moved the base into config as DefaultRetryBase so it's visible at a glance. pushed force-with-lease to keep history tidy.

ci-bot: build: linux-amd64: succeeded \u2022 tests: 128 passed, 2 skipped \u2022 coverage: 87.3%

alex: left one inline about wrapping the error with fmt.Errorf("%w") instead of fmt.Errorf("... %v", err). not blocking but prefer consistent wrapping in this package. PTAL again after that change.

jamie: updated error wrapping in the two spots alex flagged. also added a note in the CHANGELOG about the behavior being identical for callers.

priya: lgtm from me. approved. would prefer we merge after the 4pm deploy window to avoid surface-area confusion with ongoing infra changes.

jamie: thanks — planning to merge ~4:30pm then, unless alex wants it sooner. i'll hold the merge until we have both approvals.

alex: i'll try to approve in the next 20-30m. if i don't get to it, ping me again at 4:10pm.

jamie: will do — thanks both :rocket:
